text:
Ava L: Quick async check — drop what you did / blockers / today. Highlights: completed canary rollout for bert-quant on dedicated-pool-2; perf profiles look stable (~12% cost improvement). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/412 (runtime kernel fallback). Blocker: seeing intermittent 503s from pool-2 during bursts, @Ravi K can you take a look at autoscaler + node health? Also tagging @Jordan M for a quick CR when you have a moment. :rocket:

Ravi K: On it. I pulled logs — one node (node-7) had repeated OOM kills around 02:14 UTC, evicted pods then recovered. Suspect memory pressure from a long-running batch job. I'm spinning a small scale-up (2 nodes) and reapplying taints to keep batch on separate pool. Will post logs shortly.

Jordan M: Saw the PR, will do a focused review this afternoon. Noted a failing integration test in CI (SequenceCacheTest) — looks flaky. If it's just a race I'll add a small retry, otherwise I'll comment on the PR with details.

Priya S: From product side — good to see cost gains. Heads-up: support reported two customer tickets about slower embedding latency in the EU region since yesterday; might be related to routing changes. Can we hold merging the new route config until we've seen another 6h of stability?

Ava L: Sounds reasonable, @Priya S. I'll pause the route merge and keep canary running. Plan: monitor dashboards until 08:00 UTC, then decide. Thanks @Ravi K for scaling action.

infra-bot: Deploy canary: bert-quant @ dedicated-pool-2 completed — 2003123470 — status: success — metrics: p95 latency +1.1% vs baseline, token cost -11%.

Ravi K: Pushed logs here: https://logs.redwood.internal/archives/2003123456/node-7-oom.log — looks like the batch job used an unbounded cache. I've added a limit and redeployed. Will keep an eye for another 30m.

Jordan M: Started CR pass — leaving inline comments on PR 412. Main ask: add a small unit test for kernel fallback path and a comment about why we prefer the new ordering. Should be quick.

Ava L: Thanks all. Blockers resolved for now. Today's focus: (1) monitor canary + dashboards, (2) merge PR 412 after Jordan's signoff and another 6h of steady metrics, (3) follow up on EU routing telemetry with @Priya S and support. Optional 15m sync at 15:00 UTC if anyone wants to join — I'll post a Zoom if so. :white_check_mark:
